headers:
Vinyl Composite Tile is produced in 1/8-inch thickness, 12 " x 12" size and complies with the
requirements of Federal Specification SS-T-312B, Type IV Composition 1- Asbestos Free and AST<
Designation F-1066-87 Standard Specification for VCT. These product formulations do NOT contain
asbestos.
sample:
VCT meets the requirements of an "Article" as set forth in Title 29, CFR 1910.1200 Hazard
Communication and any other pertinent local, state, and federal laws, regulations and codes. These
products are (i) formed to a specific shape or design during end use, and end use function dependent
upon their shape or design during end use, and (iii) do not release any hazardous chemical under
normal condition of use.
